title: Search learning remembers opens and resets
steps: Search a word and open a result from the list
Open Settings › Search and read Opened from search
Run Reset search learning from the palette (⌘K)
Look at Opened from search again
expected: After opening a result it says 1 conversation remembered. The palette entry shows a "Search learning reset" notice and the line says no conversations are remembered. The settings themselves are unchanged. Going through results with J and K in a conversation does not count as opening them.
